caption: The drawing depicts a square textile pattern composed of interlocking circular and diamond shapes. The composition consists of a grid of large, overlapping circles, each formed by four curved, petal-like segments meeting at points. The segments alternate in color between a deep red and a light beige or cream. The red segments are decorated with evenly spaced small black dots, some of which are surrounded by a tiny white ring, while the beige segments have a subtle crosshatch texture but no additional decoration. The entire pattern is bordered by a narrow edge in a mottled, brownish color. The layout creates an optical effect of four-pointed stars and intersecting petals across the entire square. The background outside the central textile pattern is off-white. The drawing includes the artist's name and date (“Mollie Littrell 1940”) in the lower right corner.
title: Old Fashioned Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
